 Order

This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is filed by the claimant being aggrieved of the award dated 22.07.2023 passed by the learned Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Parasiya, District Chhindwara (M.P.) in MACC No.174/2022 ( Rajkumar Marskole Vs. Sohrab Khan and others), on the ground that learned Tribunal has not awarded any compensation under the head of reimbursement of medical bills.

entities.text: Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Parasiya
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Rajkumar Marskole Vs. Sohrab Khan and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. Shri Gulab Chand Sohane, learned counsel for the respondent-insurance company has drawn attention of this Court to paragraph 9 of cross-examination of claimant Rajkumar Marskole in which he has admitted that he had not produced any bills in regard to Medicare and Hi Tech hospital in respect of expenses incurred on treatment.
He has further admitted that whatever expenses were incurred on treatment, they were paid by the Government.
He has admitted that he had not made any payment to the hospital.

He also admitted that in respect of receipts from Ex.P-93 to Ex.P-108,
no payment was made by him.
He further admitted that whatever expenses were incurred on medicines, they too were given NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12011 2 MA-1646-2024 by the State.

3. In view of the such facts, when claimant himself did not incur any expenditure on medicines or treatment, as admitted by him and they were paid by somebody else, then learned Tribunal has rightly not awarded any compensation under head of medical reimbursement because compensation is towards the reimbursement of medical expenses and when tested on this ground,
Rajkumar Marskole vs Sohrab Khan on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111107086/

impugned award cannot be faulted with.

4. Learned Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.10,000/- under the head of Pain and Suffering,
therefore, a sum of Rs.25,000/- is awarded under this head.
Thus, there will be enhancement to the tune of Rs.15,000/- under the head of Pain and Suffering.
Learned Tribunal has awarded only a sum of Rs.5,000/- under the head of Transport, under which head a sum of Rs.10,000/- is awarded.

Thus, there will be enhancement to the tune of Rs.5,000/- under the head of Transport.
5.

Thus, there will be total enhancement to the tune of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty thousand only)
for which claimant will be entitled to in addition to the amount awarded by learned Claims Tribunal.
This additional amount will also earn interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of filing of claim petition till the date of actual payment.
Other terms and conditions of the award shall remain intact.
6. In above terms, the miscellaneous appeal is disposed of.
7. Record of the Claims Tribunal be sent back.
